name: traversy-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods from Brad Traversy

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: Shows branch safety, context headroom, and account usage in a compact session telemetry strip

plugins.name: tool-cards
plugins.description: Replaces tool-use rows with diagnostic cards that show status, timing, results, and details

plugins.name: next-steps
plugins.description: Suggests 2 or 3 likely next prompts after each turn, as buttons on the desktop and numbered picks in the terminal

plugins.name: source-control
plugins.description: A Source Control pane beside the chat, modeled on VS Code: changes, stage, discard, commit, and the commit graph

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds risky Bash commands and shows what they would change, or asks through the app's permission prompt where nothing can draw the hold
